# Psychology Today

> > Psychology Today is a comprehensive mental health platform offering a verified therapist directory, mental health reference guides, and evidence-based wellness resources.

Psychology Today serves as a primary resource for individuals seeking mental health support through its extensive therapist finder with location-based and specialty filtering, combined with authoritative reference materials on conditions like ADHD, anxiety, addiction, and autism spectrum disorders. The platform connects users with verified mental health professionals across major U.S. cities while providing educational content on psychological conditions and treatment approaches.

## Key Topics

- Therapist Directory
- Mental Health Services
- ADHD
- Anxiety
- Addiction
- PTSD
- Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD)
- Autism Spectrum Disorder
- EMDR Therapy
- Location-Based Search
- Specialty Filters
- Counseling Services
- Psychology Reference
- Verified Providers
- Therapy Specialties

## Mental Health Reference Guides

- [ADHD | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/adhd): Reference guide on ADHD symptoms, diagnosis, prevalence, and treatment approaches
- [Anxiety | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/anxiety): Reference guide defining anxiety, symptoms, causes, and treatment options
- [Addiction | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/addiction): Reference guide defining addiction, substance use disorders, and treatment approaches
- [Asperger's Syndrome | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/aspergers-syndrome): Reference guide on Asperger's syndrome and autism spectrum disorder classification
